title: Measurable Independence Density Equals the Finite Independence-Ratio Infimum in the Euclidean Plane
summary: Let m1(R^2) be the supremum of upper densities of Lebesgue-measurable subsets of the plane containing no pair of points at distance one. We show, using the spectral rigidity theorem in OpenAI's recent proof that the plane is not five-colorable, that m1(R^2) = inf_G alpha(G)/|V(G)|, where G ranges over nonempty finite unit-distance graphs in the plane.
